notes:
**SCCM Retro - Update 2.36.0**

A big PS2 speed win, the Community Packs follow ups you asked for, and fixes for the upload freezes.

**PS2 performance**
- New **Built-in game fixes** option per game, under Performance settings. Turning it off skips the emulator's own accuracy corrections for that title.
- **Silent Hill 3 goes from 20 fps to a locked 30 fps at full speed**, with the flashlight, fog and lighting all turned back on. No need to strip effects for speed any more.
- This is not a general speed switch. Most games see nothing, and on a few the correction is what stops a crash, so turn it back on if anything looks or behaves worse.
- Silent Hill 3 owners: also set Hardware readbacks to Asynchronous and EE cycle skip to 0. Vsync can stay on now.

**Community Packs**
- Every pack shows **its own description**, so you can tell what a pack does before switching it on.
- A pack with a single choice shows **its current value right on the row**. Press right and A to change it, no extra menu.
- **Controller scrolling is fixed** in long pack lists and in every long choice list in the pre-launch menu. The cursor stays on screen.

**Uploads**
- An interrupted upload now **continues where it left off** when you upload the same file again. It always could, but the page wrongly called it an installed duplicate and offered to keep both.
- Titles you already own now offer **Replace** as well as Keep both. Replace removes the old copy when the new one is placed.
- **Unfinished uploads can be deleted**, from the upload page and from the Uploading tab on the console. Idle ones are cleaned up on their own after 30 minutes.
- **Large uploads should no longer freeze the console.** When space is tight the console moves games to the SD card to make room, and that copy ran flat out, which could starve everything else. Copies are now paced, and uploads pause while it happens.

**Network**
- When a network cable is connected the console **uses it and turns WiFi off**, and switches back when you unplug. A radio you turned off yourself is never touched.
- The **console's IP address now shows in the header**, so you can reach the upload page without digging through Settings.

**Themes**
- The Primary and Secondary colour sliders gained **8 grayscale steps, white through black**, at the end of the track.
- The colour sliders now actually show their colours. The rainbow strip was there all along but never drew.
- Picking **Clean Dark or Clean Light now switches the background** to the plain one, custom images included. You can still pick any background afterwards.

**Fixed**
- The performance overlay no longer shows up cut off. It could be clipped to a sliver depending on timing, which is also why it sometimes looked like it had not appeared at all.
- Deep sleep no longer refuses with "the console is on external power" when you are on battery.

**Known issues**
- The deep sleep fix is not yet confirmed on a console running on battery. Please report back.
- Wired Ethernet priority could not be tested on real Ethernet hardware here. Reports welcome, especially unplugging mid session.
- The upload freeze fix targets the most likely cause found in the code. If it happens again, please send a debug bundle from right after it, it would confirm the diagnosis.

Released OTA
